data.text/html: Temperature averaged over the mask, by level. Strongest guided warming near the surface; it fades — and flips sign — higher up.
Same, but the guided temperature itself (no difference). Mask-region mean by level — the profile the guided run lands on.
Guided temperature distribution, by level. Slide up: the chosen level is solid; higher (colder) levels trail behind, fainter.
2 m temperature distribution over forecast steps. Each step's density, offset — the distribution shifts as the forecast advances.
2 m temperature. Guidance acts inside the mask (bleeds a little past it); land warms, and the cooler patches are pushed hardest — a fill-in.
Temperature, 1000 hPa.
Temperature, 925 hPa. The signal disperses more over land with height.
Specific humidity, 1000 hPa. Up on the sea side, down over land; the humid band right of the mask lines up with the temperature dip there.
10 m wind (u, v). The wind change lifts temperature even over the sea.
